text: The Patriots head to Buffalo on Sunday for a Week 4 matchup against Josh Allen and the Bills, with Matt Pryor joining the offensive line as the team continues to shuffle its infrastructure around Drake Maye—though the young quarterback insists his right shoulder is fine and the real issue lies in decision-making rather than physical limitations. New England's offense remains in freefall, dead last in the NFL at 9.7 points per game, and now faces the added blow of losing guard Greg Van Roten to injured reserve with a thigh injury, compounding what's already a 1-2 start that demands immediate correction. On a brighter note, wide receiver Mack Hollins was named the Week 4 NFLPA Community MVP after hosting a Special Olympics Family Field Day for over 125 athletes and their families, reminding us that character matters even when the scoreboard doesn't cooperate. The stage is set for Sunday at 1 PM ET as experts weigh in with their picks for what shapes up as a crucial divisional matchup.
